","configure_owner_proxy.py":""""Configure the owner's HTTP CONNECT proxy without exposing credentials in tools.

This must be run locally in an interactive Windows terminal, not by PC relay.
No global/proxifier/TGWS settings are modified.
"""
import getpass, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error, http.client
from owner_proxy import PRIVATE_FILE,HOST,PORT,proxy_url
from secrets_store import write as dpapi_write, SecretError
from telegram_transport import open_telegram,ProxyTransportError
from urllib.parse import quote

def preflight(url):
    req=urllib.request.Request("https://api.telegram.org/")
    try:
        with open_telegram(req,proxy=url,timeout=14) as result:
            code=result.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        code=e.code
    except (OSError,urllib.error.URLError,http.client.HTTPException,ProxyTransportError) as e:
        print("PROXY_CONNECT_FAILED:"+type(e).__name__)
        return False
    if code not in (200,404):
        print("PROXY_CONNECT_UNCONFIRMED_HTTP_"+str(code))
        return False
    print("TELEGRAM_HTTPS_OVER_PROXY_VERIFIED")
    return True

def main():
    if os.name!="nt" or not sys.stdin.isatty():
        print("LOCAL_INTERACTIVE_WINDOWS_REQUIRED")
        return 2
    print("Private Telegram Bot API HTTP CONNECT setup")
    print("Existing upstream port:",PORT,"; SOCKS5 port is not needed.")
    print("Only this Telegram gateway will use it, never Windows/Proxifier.")
    if PRIVATE_FILE.exists():
        print("Private proxy credentials already exist. Testing saved credentials without printing them.")
        try:
            return 0 if preflight(proxy_url()) else 2
        except SecretError as e:
            print("PROXY_STORE_UNAVAILABLE")
            return 2
    print("Enter your proxy username and password here on this PC only.")
    print("Login/password will be held in Windows DPAPI; NOT sent to GitHub/ChatGPT.")
    username=getpass.getpass("Proxy username (hidden): ").strip()
    password=getpass.getpass("Proxy password (hidden): ")
    if not username or not password or len(username)>255 or len(password)>255:
        print("PROXY_CREDENTIAL_FORMAT_INVALID")
        return 2
    url="http://"+quote(username,safe="")+":"+quote(password,safe="")+"@"+HOST+":"+str(PORT)
    if not preflight(url):
        print("Credential store NOT created; confirm upstream proxy account is active.")
        return 2
    dpapi_write({"mode":"http-connect-basic-v1","username":username,"password":password},PRIVATE_FILE)
    print("PRIVATE_PROXY_CONFIGURED; DPAPI encrypted; network verified.")
    print("Next: CHECK_TELEGRAM_NETWORK.cmd; then SETUP_BOT.cmd using a NEW rotated BotFather token.")
    return 0

if __name__=="__main__":
    try:sys.exit(main())
    except SecretError:
        print("PROXY_LOCAL_SECRET_STORE_ERROR")
        sys.exit(2)
","test_owner_proxy.py":""""Offline Basic-auth HTTP CONNECT/TLS and DPAPI routing tests; synthetic credentials only."""
import os,unittest,urllib.request,http.client,socket,ssl
from unittest.mock import patch
import owner_proxy
import telegram_transport

class DummySocket:
    def close(self):pass

class OwnerHTTPProxyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_host_and_port_are_explicit_and_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(owner_proxy.HOST,"104.165.1.52")
        self.assertEqual(owner_proxy.PORT,6637)
    def test_proxy_url_missing_file_is_empty(self):
        with patch.object(owner_proxy,"PRIVATE_FILE",__import__('pathlib').Path("/unavailable/file.dpapi")):
            self.assertEqual(owner_proxy.proxy_url(),"")
    def test_proxy_read_only_uses_dpapi(self):
        from pathlib import Path
        with patch.object(owner_proxy,"PRIVATE_FILE",Path(__file__)):
            with patch.object(owner_proxy,"dpapi_read",return_value={
                    "mode":"http-connect-basic-v1",
                    "username":"synthetic-person",
                    "password":"synthetic-p-w"}):
                url=owner_proxy.proxy_url()
        self.assertTrue(url.startswith("http://synthetic-person:"))
        self.assertTrue(url.endswith(":6637"))
    def test_http_connect_auth_handler_no_duplicate_timeout(self):
        req=urllib.request.Request("https://api.telegram.org/")
        result_marker=object()
        calls=[]
        def fake_do_open(self,klass,request,**kwargs):
            self.assertNotIn("timeout",kwargs)
            calls.append((klass,request,kwargs))
            c=klass("api.telegram.org",timeout=9)
            self.assertEqual(c.timeout,9)
            return result_marker
        # Bound method needs a patch wrapper, not this TestCase's self.
        def spy(handler,klass,request,**kwargs):
            if kwargs:raise AssertionError("duplicate timeout")
            calls.append(klass)
            self.assertTrue(issubclass(klass,http.client.HTTPSConnection))
            c=klass("api.telegram.org",timeout=9)
            self.assertEqual(c.timeout,9)
            return result_marker
        with patch.object(urllib.request.AbstractHTTPHandler,"do_open",spy):
            actual=telegram_transport.open_telegram(
                req,proxy="http://synthetic-user:synthetic-pass@104.165.1.52:6637",timeout=9)
        self.assertIs(actual,result_marker)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls),1)
    def test_proxy_basic_header_and_telegram_tls_sni(self):
        req=urllib.request.Request("https://api.telegram.org/")
        saved=[]
        wrapped=DummySocket()
        with patch.object(urllib.request.AbstractHTTPHandler,"do_open",
                          lambda handler,klass,request,**kwargs: klass("api.telegram.org",timeout=9)) as noop:
            c=telegram_transport.open_telegram(
                req,proxy="http://synthetic-user:synthetic-pass@104.165.1.52:6637",timeout=9)
        with patch.object(socket,"create_connection",return_value=DummySocket()) as sock, \
             patch.object(http.client.HTTPConnection,"_tunnel",autospec=True) as tunnel, \
             patch.object(ssl.SSLContext,"wrap_socket",return_value=wrapped) as tls:
            c.connect()
        self.assertEqual(sock.call_args.args[0],("104.165.1.52",6637))
        self.assertEqual(c._tunnel_host,"api.telegram.org")
        self.assertIn("Proxy-Authorization",c._tunnel_headers)
        self.assertTrue(c._tunnel_headers["Proxy-Authorization"].startswith("Basic "))
        self.assertEqual(tls.call_args.kwargs.get("server_hostname"),"api.telegram.org")
        self.assertIs(c.sock,wrapped)

if __name__=="__main__": unittest.main()
